problem: The eigenvector of $A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ 2k+1 & -k\end{aligned}]$ corresponding to the eigenvalue $\lambda =2k$ is  $[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$ Determine the value of $k.$

activity_context.topic_title: The Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors of a 2x2 Matrix

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14095012/assets/952f35d03c8554f2feaeb50296df9ac426a49730a44038bf6f9cf47b1fa3f9ee.png)

The vector $v$ is an eigenvector of a $2\times 2$ matrix $A$ corresponding to the eigenvalue $\frac{5}{2}.$ Find the vector $Av.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The eigenvector $v=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ corresponds to the eigenvalue $\lambda =\frac{5}{2}.$ So, 

$$
\begin{aligned}Av & =\frac{5}{2}v.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have the following picture:
